title: Initiative Radar & Commitment Consolidator for Quarterly OKR Glidepath
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Build a canonical quarterly 'Initiative Radar' and commitment consolidator that rolls company-level OKRs into a single glidepath for cross-functional teams. The consolidator will: aggregate initiative commitments and capacity, surface conflicts and risks, produce a heatmap of confidence vs. impact, and feed downstream artifacts (roadmap view, handoff tickets, executive readout). Goal is to reduce cross-team misalignment during quarter planning and enable faster escalations when scope or capacity shifts.
acceptance_criteria: Consolidator doc (Confluence) with schema for initiative commitments and SLAs is published and linked
Automated rollup script validates and aggregates initiatives from team sheets and outputs a canonical CSV/JSON used by dashboards
Radar heatmap prototype in Looker/Console shows confidence vs. impact for all company-level initiatives
Stakeholder sign-off from Product, Eng, Design, and Finance on escalation gates and capacity assumptions
Playbook for weekly cadence (who updates, who reviews, what triggers escalation) is documented and shared

notes: Design trade-off: radial vs. matrix—matrix preferred for quick scanning of >30 initiatives; radial is more narrative for execs
Confidence scoring to be derived from three signals: resourcing fidelity, historical delivery variance, and external dependency count
We will reuse existing rollout channels: biweekly PM sync, weekly ENG triage, and Friday exec readout during the pilot
risks: Incomplete or stale data from team sheets leads to misleading radar — mitigated by weekly validation job
Disagreement on capacity assumptions across Eng squads may delay sign-off — mitigated by explicit escalation path and two-week freeze window
Dashboard performance with large initiative sets; may require backend pagination and caching
